summary: Iteration 22: Admin-controlled Try Out session (schedule + monitor + reset/retake). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering schedule_status in admin+student lists, upcoming/closed enforcement (403 on detail+start), autosave progress (saved_at), timer computed from server (reload does not reset timer), monitor endpoint (summary/rows/server_now + retake_pending row after reset), reset creates retake grant and causes stale progress PUT to return 404, retake bypasses closed schedule, cancel_retake removes grant, force_submit grades saved answers. Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): admin ManageTryouts shows tryout-schedule-fields with tryout-start-at/tryout-end-at datetime-local; saving end<=start shows validation feedback; monitor-{id} 'Pantau Peserta' button present on 3 cards and navigates to /admin/tryouts/{id}/monitor which renders tryout-monitor with stat-in-progress, stat-expired, stat-retake, stat-submitted, monitor-refresh. Student /student/tryouts shows tryout-schedule-{id} 'Try Out sudah ditutup' block for closed tryout (to_1/to_2). Starting to_3 (open) renders TryoutEngine: exam-timer shows 29:57, selecting an option triggers autosave with exam-save-status 'Tersimpan di server 06.43.20'; after full page reload, timer continues at 29:49 (NOT reset to 30:00) and selected answer persists -> confirms server-driven timer + answer persistence from PUT /api/student/attempts/{id}/progress.

issues: data-testid='monitor-schedule' element may be rendered conditionally; was not found on the monitored tryout page when no start_at/end_at was set (minor; stats + refresh work).

critical_code_review_comments: tryout_session.remaining_seconds correctly caps left by (end-now) only when not bypass_schedule; retake attempts correctly ignore the end bound and receive the full fresh duration. Verified via test_retake_bypasses_closed_schedule.
routes_student.save_progress returns 409 when attempt status != in_progress and 404 when attempt deleted (reset path): both allowed by UI so client can redirect+toast. Good.

routes_admin.reset_attempt deletes ALL attempts (including submitted) for that student+tryout then creates a retake grant; _recalibrate_tryout is scheduled only if the reset attempt was submitted. OK.
routes_admin.list_tryouts filters kind!=exercise; exercises not affected by schedule (confirmed by code path and schedule_status not evaluated on exercise in student start_attempt).
routes_student.start_attempt returns existing in_progress attempt (preserves started_at) so timer never resets on page reload. Confirmed in UI test (29:57 -> 29:49).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (schedule UI + autosave + server timer + monitor stats)
